country.pick: In which modern country do you find the ancient city of {label}?
country.statement: The ancient city of {label} lies in modern {value}.
country.match: Match each ancient city to the modern country it lies in.

rows.label: Troy
rows.description: ancient Homeric-era city in northwest Asia Minor; it is known as the setting for the Greek myth of the Trojan war
rows.hook: was the legendary site of a ten-year war ended by a giant wooden horse trick

rows.label: Constantinople
rows.description: capital of the Eastern Roman, Latin and Ottoman Empires, currently Istanbul, Turkey
rows.hook: was the long-time capital of the Byzantine Empire before being renamed Istanbul

rows.label: Pompeii
rows.description: ancient Roman city near modern Naples, Italy
rows.hook: was buried under volcanic ash when Mount Vesuvius erupted, freezing Roman life in place

rows.label: Athens
rows.description: capital and largest city of Greece
rows.hook: is the birthplace of democracy and home to the Parthenon on its Acropolis

rows.label: Sparta
rows.description: city and city-state in ancient Greece
rows.hook: was a Greek city-state famed for its fierce, disciplined, militarized warriors

rows.label: Damascus
rows.description: capital and largest city of Syria
rows.hook: is often called the oldest continuously inhabited capital city in the world

rows.label: Petra
rows.description: ancient rock-cut historical city in Jordan
rows.hook: is a rose-red city carved into sandstone cliffs, one of the New Seven Wonders

rows.label: Carthage
rows.description: historical city in Tunisia
rows.hook: was the great North African rival of Rome in the Punic Wars

rows.label: Alexandria
rows.description: port city on the Mediterranean coast of Egypt
rows.hook: was founded by a Macedonian conqueror and housed a legendary ancient library and lighthouse

rows.label: Nineveh
rows.description: ancient Assyrian city, capital of the Neo-Assyrian Empire

rows.label: Mycenae
rows.description: ancient city, now an archaeological site in Argolis, Greece
rows.hook: was the legendary stronghold of King Agamemnon, entered through the Lion Gate

rows.label: Antioch
rows.description: ancient Greek city in southern Turkey
rows.hook: was a major Seleucid capital where followers of Jesus were first called Christians

rows.label: Uruk
rows.description: ancient city of Sumer and Babylonia

rows.label: Persepolis
rows.description: ancient city in Marvdasht County, Iranian national heritage site and World heritage site
rows.hook: was the ceremonial capital of the ancient Persian empire, later burned by Alexander the Great

rows.label: Mohenjo-daro
rows.description: archaeological site in the province of Sindh, Pakistan

rows.label: Delphi
rows.description: ancient town in Fokida, Greece
rows.hook: was home to the famous oracle who gave cryptic prophecies to kings and travelers

rows.label: Tyre
rows.description: city in the South Governorate of Lebanon, also an ancient Phoenician city and the legendary birthplace of Europa and Elissa (Dido)
rows.hook: was a Phoenician port famed for its purple dye and as the legendary birthplace of Europa

rows.label: Knossos
rows.description: ancient Minoan through Roman administrative center and city
rows.hook: was the Minoan palace linked to the legend of the Minotaur in the labyrinth

rows.label: Syracuse
rows.description: Italian municipality
rows.hook: was the home of the mathematician Archimedes and a one-time rival of Athens

rows.label: Trier
rows.description: city in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

rows.label: Herculaneum
rows.description: Roman town destroyed by eruption of Mount Vesuvius
rows.hook: was buried by the same volcanic eruption as Pompeii, preserving wood and food

rows.label: Ancient Corinth
rows.description: city-state in ancient Greece
rows.hook: was a wealthy Greek trading city on a narrow isthmus, later visited by Saint Paul

rows.label: Pergamon
rows.description: ancient city of Ionia in modern-day Turkey and UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: was a wealthy Hellenistic capital with a great library and a steep hilltop theatre

rows.label: Ctesiphon
rows.description: capital of the Iranian empire in the Parthian and Sasanian eras in present Iraq

rows.label: Ugarit
rows.description: ancient port city in northern Syria

rows.label: Merv
rows.description: archaeological site in Turkmenistan

rows.label: Palmyra
rows.description: ancient city in Homs Governorate, Syria
rows.hook: was a wealthy desert caravan city ruled by the rebel queen Zenobia

rows.label: Ujjain
rows.description: ancient city beside the Kshipra River in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh

rows.label: Olympia
rows.description: town on the Peloponnese peninsula in Greece, site of the ancient Olympic Games
rows.hook: hosted the ancient athletic games held every four years in honor of Zeus

rows.label: Taranto
rows.description: Italian comune

rows.label: Pella
rows.description: capital of the ancient kingdom of Macedon

rows.label: Susa
rows.description: ancient city in Iran, World Heritage site in Iran

rows.label: Baalbek
rows.description: city in Baalbek-Hermel, Lebanon
rows.hook: is known for enormous Roman temples to Jupiter and Bacchus among the largest in the empire

rows.label: Miletus
rows.description: ancient city of Ionia, in modern-day Turkey
